Works out of the box."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Screenshots"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Overview"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"An Electron desktop shell that embeds the official DeepSeek Harness Web UI. On startup it lets you p"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ick an **installation mode**, then automatically handles environment detection, installation, and se"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"rvice startup — with a **percentage progress bar** for every stage. When the service is ready, the m"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"ain UI opens automatically."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"No command-line memorization, no manual service startup — just double-click and go."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"> **New-dsh auth fully auto-adapted (v1.11.0)**: dsh `0.1.2-rc.1+` enforces browser-session auth on "},{"id":"p10s2","text":"the Web UI. The desktop app automatically captures the access token dsh prints at startup and uses i"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"t to open the main window (exchanges a 30-day cookie, then returns to the clean bare URL) — no manua"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"l `?token=` handling. Mobile remote access also supports **bare-URL direct entry** with plugin `@fei"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"yang666/dsh-mobile-remote >= 1.8.0`. See RELEASE_NOTES.md and CHANGELOG.md.
>
> **DeepSeek V4.1 Flas"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"h supported (v1.12.0)**: update the runtime to the latest official dsh (Instant Start "Update Now" /"},{"id":"p10s7","text":" Settings → "Runtime (dsh)") and the official Web UI offers the new model **`deepseek-flash` (DeepSe"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"ek-V4.1-Flash)** alongside `deepseek-v4-pro`; also upgrade the **Usage & Cost plugin to ≥ 1.17.0** s"},{"id":"p10s9","text":"o costs are billed with the new peak/off-peak prices effective 2026-09-10 12:00 Beijing time. The de"},{"id":"p10s10","text":"sktop app itself needs no model configuration changes.

[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### Other Features"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- **No terminal windows**: all subprocesses run directly via `node`, no console popups
- **Automatic"},{"id":"p13s2","text":" environment detection**: guides you when Node.js/git/pnpm are missing (download button for Node, do"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"wnload hint for git, auto-install for pnpm)
- **Automatic service startup**: reuses an existing serv"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"ice on port 3080 when available; otherwise starts `dsh web`. If the port is held by something this a"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"pp did not start (dsh 0.1.7 supports multiple coexisting DSH instances), the occupant (process name "},{"id":"p13s6","text":"+ PID) is reported before it is ended, instead of being killed silently
- **Plugin ↔ dsh version com"},{"id":"p13s7","text":"patibility**: the same peer-range check the official installer/launcher performs on `@deepseek-ai/ds"},{"id":"p13s8","text":"h` / `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` (pre-install registry pre-check, post-install re-check for tarball/directo"},{"id":"p13s9","text":"ry installs); incompatible plugins are flagged in both the recommended cards and the installed list,"},{"id":"p13s10","text":" and can be allowed through a one-click **exact-version exemption** written to the profile's `compat"},{"id":"p13s11","text":"ibility.json` (equivalent to `dsh plugin allow-version`; applies to that exact version only)
- **Off"},{"id":"p13s12","text":"icial startup diagnostics recognized**: official 0.1.7 failure/degradation signals (plugin or bundle"},{"id":"p13s13","text":" skipped as incompatible, a required plugin entry failing, sections of the legacy `settings.yaml` no"},{"id":"p13s14","text":"t migrated, a patch entry that does not exist) get an actionable Chinese/English hint in the log pan"},{"id":"p13s15","text":"el; a startup timeout also reports the recognized diagnostic
- **Repair keeps your preferences**: si"},{"id":"p13s16","text":"nce 0.1.7 user settings and agent presets live inside the profile, "Local Repair" now stashes `ui-th"},{"id":"p13s17","text":"eme` / `preset-*` entries and version exemptions before deleting `profiles/`, and merges them back o"},{"id":"p13s18","text":"nce the service starts successfully again
- **System tray**: closing the window minimizes to tray wh"},{"id":"p13s19","text":"ile the service keeps running; exit from tray menu
- **Clean exit**: automatically `taskkill`s the d"},{"id":"p13s20","text":"sh process tree on quit
- **Packaging**: `electron-builder` generates a Windows installer"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## System Requirements"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| Dependency | Notes |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| Windows 10 / 11 (x64) | Runtime platform |
| Node.js ≥ 18 | Required for Instant Start mode; the c"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"lient guides installation if missing |
| git | Only needed for source mode (pnpm auto-installs if mi"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"ssing) |
| Network | First install downloads dependencies (~hundreds of MB) |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"> The client guides you through installing anything missing — no manual setup required."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### How Instant Start works (why it is second-level and offline-capable)"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"**Why was the old "Quick Start" slow?** Quick Start ran `npm exec --yes -- @deepseek-ai/dsh web` (np"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"x). The official dsh package is split into **150+ interdependent sub-packages** (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-*"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"`), and `npm exec` does the following on every startup:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"1. Resolves `latest` from the registry (one HTTP round-trip);
2. Sends an HTTP request for **each su"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"b-package** to revalidate its version (`cache revalidated`), even when the local cache already exist"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"s;
3. Unpacks each tarball into a fresh npx sandbox directory."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Serializing the validation + unpacking of those 150+ packages takes **100~200 seconds** even with a "},{"id":"p21s2","text":"fully warm cache (especially on domestic networks) — that is the root cause of a 200+ second service"},{"id":"p21s3","text":" startup. **It is not a slow network; npm is re-resolving the whole dependency tree every time.**"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"**What Instant Start does:** it fully separates "install" from "launch" — **install once, launch man"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"tant Start does:** it fully separates "install" from "launch" — **install once, launch many times**:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- **First run (needs network once)**: runs `npm install @deepseek-ai/dsh --prefix <userData>/dsh-loc"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"al --ignore-scripts`, fully unpacking dsh and all 150+ dependencies into a local fixed directory (`%"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"APPDATA%\dsh-desktop\dsh-local\node_modules`), forming a "ready" dependency tree on disk. Uses the d"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"omestic mirror (npmmirror) with automatic fallback.
- **Every subsequent launch (fully offline)**: `"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"spawn(node, [<dsh-local>/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js, 'web', ...])` — the Node.js proce"},{"id":"p23s6","text":"ss loads the locally unpacked `bin.js` entry directly. **No npm involved**: no `latest` resolution, "},{"id":"p23s7","text":"no HTTP requests, no tarball validation, no unpacking. Node's `require` hits the local `node_modules"},{"id":"p23s8","text":"` directly, and the service is ready within seconds.
- The working directory matches Quick/Repair mo"},{"id":"p23s9","text":"des (`resolveWorkspaceDir()`), so session-history ownership is unchanged."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
